'''2000 Concord Dawn Regionals''' was the Star Wars CCG regional championship for the Concord Dawn region (France) in the 2000 Decipher championship circuit.<ref name="dc00fin">[http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html DecipherCon 2000: Star Wars CCG Qualifiers], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010308110320/http://decipher.com/tournaments/deciphercon2000/swfinalists.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="rl00concorddawn">[http://christo.decipher.com/regionals/swlist.html?game=sw&region=concorddawn 2000 Regionals: Concord Dawn], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010726150258/http://christo.decipher.com/regionals/swlist.html?game=sw&region=concorddawn Internet Archive]</ref>

[[Sylvain Duc]] of Marly-le-Roi, France won and qualified for the [[2000 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dc00fin" />

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Regional championship
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Date:''' 1 July 2000
* '''Site:''' OSTELEN Paris, France
